questions.question: I am surprised ______ the exam is pretty difficult.
questions.explanation: be surprised that… 后的 should 表“竟然”，不是“应该”。这里惊讶的是“你竟觉得考试很难”，不是考试本身很难。

questions.question: In "He will come to learn driving from you", the infinitive indicates ______.
questions.explanation: to learn… 说明来这里的目的，作目的状语。

questions.question: Tom told his father ______ had happened.
questions.explanation: all 是 told 的宾语，that 引导定语从句并在从句中作主语；整体相当于 what had happened。

questions.question: Many reporters hurried to the airport, only to be told that the superstar had already left. The infinitive verb phrase only to be told is used ______.

options.text: to indicate a high degree of possibility

questions.explanation: only to do 在此引出出乎意料且令人失望的结果：赶到机场却被告知明星已经离开。

questions.question: In doing experiments, you must be ______ the precision instruments.
questions.explanation: more than + 形容词 = 非常、十分；be careful with = 小心对待。这里没有比较对象，不能拆成 more careful than。

questions.question: Everyone has climbed up to the top of the mountain, ______?
questions.explanation: 主句为现在完成时的肯定句，反意疑问用 haven't；everyone 可由 they 承接。

questions.question: Little ______ what was upsetting me.
questions.explanation: 否定意义的 Little 位于句首，用部分倒装；was upsetting 表明过去语境，借助 did。

questions.question: ______ more attention, the trees could have grown better.
questions.explanation: Given more attention = If the trees had been given more attention。树是“被照料”，用过去分词；could have grown 暗示对过去的假设。此处 given 是分词，不宜只记成“考虑到”的介词。

questions.question: It's no good ______ her. She is such a miser that she won't spare a penny out.
questions.explanation: It's no good doing… 表示做某事无益；turn to sb 表示向某人求助。

questions.question: In "We listened eagerly, for he brought news of our families", "for" is used to indicate ______.
questions.explanation: for 连接两个分句，在此补充说明急切聆听的原因。

questions.question: ______, he should be punished if he goes against the law.

options.text: Whether the president or the citizen
Was he the president or the citizen
Be he the president or the citizen
Were he the president or the citizen

questions.explanation: Be he A or B = Whether he be A or B，意为“不论他是 A 还是 B”。这是保留动词原形 be 的正式旧式句型；不要靠日常语感改成 was。

questions.question: It is generally believed that teaching is ______ it is a science.
questions.explanation: as much an art as a science = 既是一门科学，也同样是一门艺术。顺序是 as much + a/an + 单数名词 + as，不是 as an art much。

questions.question: The rhetorical question "Is that a reason for despair?" implies ______.
questions.explanation: 反问意在否定：这不是绝望的理由，而非真正询问信息。

questions.question: John wants to visit me today. I'd rather he ______ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: would rather + 主语 + 过去式，表示现在或将来的愿望；tomorrow 也用 came。若遗憾过去已发生的事，则用 had done，见 42-9。

questions.question: Mr. Wells has found some new clues in his investigation, ______ of great importance to solve this criminal case.
questions.explanation: 先去掉插入语 I think，得到 which is of great importance。逗号后不能用 that；which 已作主语，不能再加 it。这里单数 is 按“发现新线索这件事”理解；若指 clues 本身，应为 are。

questions.question: Susan is ______ as an “addlehead”—she always leaves her keys on the door.
questions.explanation: what is known as… = 所谓的、被称作……的那种人或事物。what 引导名词性表语从句；这里重在称呼或类别，不是普通的 who 定语从句。

questions.question: Old ______ my grandpa is, he works like a young man.
questions.explanation: 形容词前置的 Old as… 构成让步从句，相当于 Although my grandpa is old。

questions.question: What does the present progressive in the sentence "The doctor is coming in a minute" indicate?

options.text: An ongoing action in the present.
An action about to happen very soon.
A habitual action in a long time.
A plan of action for the nurse.

questions.explanation: is coming 配合 in a minute 表示即将发生的行动，而非此刻正在进行的动作。

questions.question: A recent survey shows that most adolescents eat ______ as they actually need every day.
questions.explanation: 倍数表达的顺序为 three times + as much + 不可数名词 + as。

questions.question: No sooner ______ his speech than listeners put forward questions.
questions.explanation: No sooner 位于句首用部分倒装；与过去事件 put forward 配合，用 had he finished。

questions.question: Susan ______ a book about cooking last year, but I don't know whether she has finished it.
questions.explanation: was writing 只说明去年在写，不保证写完；wrote a book 通常把写书视为完成的整体事件。后半句明确“是否完成尚不知”，因此选 A。

questions.question: Mr. James is such a good teacher ______ we all love and respect.
questions.explanation: love 和 respect 后缺宾语，as 在定语从句中充当宾语，组成 such…as。若选结果连词 that，从句通常须有 him：such a good teacher that we all love and respect him。

questions.question: The present simple in “I will telephone you directly I hear the news” is used to indicate ______.
questions.explanation: directly 在这里 = as soon as，意为“一……就……”，引导时间状语从句；hear 用一般现在时表达将来，遵循主将从现。

questions.question: All of the plants now farmed on a large scale were developed from plants ______ wild.
questions.explanation: that 引导修饰 plants 的定语从句并作主语；其余选项缺少正确的连接结构。

questions.question: The sentence "If he had married Alice, how happy he would have been!" expresses ______.
questions.explanation: had married 与 would have been 构成对过去未实现情况的反事实假设，感叹句表达遗憾。

questions.question: "—Must I come at four o'clock?" "—No, you needn't come at four o'clock." The modal auxiliary verbs in the conversation imply ______.
questions.explanation: must 询问是否必要，needn't 否定必要性，表示不必四点来。

questions.question: Sorry I'm late. I ______ have turned off the alarm clock and gone back to sleep again.
questions.explanation: might have done 表示对过去情况的不确定推测；迟到者推测自己可能关掉闹钟后又睡了。

questions.question: The newly designed bedroom seems to be a great deal larger than ______.
questions.explanation: than is necessary = 比所需要的还……，比较从句可保留 is necessary 而不出现显式主语。a great deal 修饰 larger，意为“大得多”。固定识别 than is necessary。

questions.question: He was determined to sail around the world ______ his illness and old age.
questions.explanation: despite 直接接名词短语，表示尽管；although 后接从句，in spite 还须接 of。

questions.question: It is not ______ much his appearance I like as his personality.
questions.explanation: not so much A as B = 与其说 A，不如说 B。这里是“与其说喜欢外貌，不如说喜欢性格”；his appearance 后省略关系词 that。

questions.question: There is much chance ______ Bill will recover from his injury in time for the race.
questions.explanation: that 引导说明 chance 内容的同位语从句；从句本身结构完整。

questions.question: I don't think ______ possible to master a foreign language without much memory work.
questions.explanation: think it possible to do 中 it 作形式宾语，真正宾语是后面的不定式。

questions.question: Which of the following italicized parts explains PURPOSE?

options.text: He is such an honest man that we all believe in him.
Please open the window so that we can breathe fresh air.
I returned home in a hurry, only to find my house broken into.
He had so little education that he was unfit for this job.

questions.explanation: B 的 so that 从句说明开窗的目的；A、D 表结果，C 表意外结果。

questions.question: If you have really been living in France for so many years, it’s about time you ______ able to talk with people in French.
questions.explanation: It is (about/high) time + 主语 + 过去式 = 早该……了。这里 were 表现在应有而尚未实现的状态。不能套用 necessary that 的原形虚拟；另一种形式是 should be，should 不省略。

questions.question: He ______ have been nervous because he didn't go straight in.
questions.explanation: because 后给出判断依据；must have been 表示推断他当时一定紧张。

questions.question: Some researchers believe that there is no doubt ______ recycling saves energy and raw materials, and reduces pollution.
questions.explanation: there is no doubt that… 表示毫无疑问，that 引导说明 doubt 内容的从句。

questions.question: It is clearly stated on the bulletin that ______ throws the rubbish away at will will be punished.
questions.explanation: whoever throws… = anyone who throws…，整体作 will be punished 的主语。两个 will：第一个属于 at will“任意地”，第二个才是将来时助动词；不要误认为重复谓语。

questions.question: "Is that true? Aren't you stretching it a bit?" These two questions are used to ______.
questions.explanation: 询问是否属实并质疑是否夸大，是表达怀疑，尚未直接否定事实。

questions.question: They are such a big family that this new house is not ______ for them to live in.
questions.explanation: enough 修饰形容词时后置：large enough；一家人多，房子不够大。

questions.question: ______ that the environment continues to be damaged at the current rate, it will not be long before the earth is totally destroyed.
questions.explanation: assuming that = 假如、假定；concerning/regarding = 关于，通常接名词或名词短语；ascertain = 查明。条件假设选 Assuming。

questions.question: ______ that is put forward is adoptable.
questions.explanation: Not every plan 作主语，that is put forward 作定语从句；表达并非每个提出的计划都可采纳。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: All the guests had a good time.
Many her students passed the exam.

questions.explanation: many 不能直接置于 her students 前，应说 many of her students；其余限定词排列正确。

questions.question: The manager has anticipated the situation that we ______ a certain amount of resistance to our plan.
questions.explanation: anticipate 预料将发生什么，不是建议、要求；同位语从句照实际时态使用 will meet。不能因 that 或 anticipated 的“设想感”就套原形虚拟。

questions.question: Many a delegate was in favor of his proposal that a special committee ______ to investigate the incident.
questions.explanation: proposal 表建议，that 从句用 (should) + 原形；委员会“被设立”，用 be set up。Many a + 单数名词 + 单数谓语，所以原句 was 正确。

questions.question: They gained ______ fat as could be expected, and it was all in their belly area.
questions.explanation: 不可数名词 fat 的倍数比较为 twice as much fat as…；倍数放在 as much 前。

questions.question: "What if we move the picture over there? Do you think it'll look better?" These two questions are used to ask for ______.
questions.explanation: 提出挪动图片的设想并询问效果，是向对方征求意见、建议。

questions.question: The Greens went to Qingdao to visit some friends, and spent the ______ days at the seaside.
questions.explanation: 限定次序为 last + few + 描写形容词 sunny + 名词 days。

questions.question: Please contact us at 4777 8886 whenever ______.

options.text: it will be convenient to you

questions.explanation: convenient 通常以 it 作主语表示事情方便；时间从句表达将来时用一般现在时。

questions.question: —Do you like orange juice? —Yes. So much ______ that I drink it almost every day in summer.
questions.explanation: so much so that… = 到了这样的程度，以至于……。第二个 so 承接前面的“喜欢”，不是多余单词；这是整段承接表达，不是普通 so much + 名词 + that。

questions.question: Which of the following italicized phrases indicates CAUSE?

options.text: The temperature varies from 30 degrees to minus 20.
I work hard so as to get promoted.
For all his efforts, he didn't pass the exam.
I was frightened at the terrible sight.

questions.explanation: D 表示因看到可怕景象而害怕，说明原因；A 表范围，B 表目的，C 表让步。

questions.question: The sentence that expresses COMPLAINT is ______.

options.text: How did you find the new product?
Where will you go this weekend?
Couldn't you be a little bit quiet?

questions.explanation: Couldn't you be a little bit quiet? 以否定疑问形式抱怨对方不够安静。

questions.question: In phrases like steaming hot, shining bright, biting cold, the -ING participle is used ______.
questions.explanation: 这些 -ing 形式强化后面形容词的程度，如热气腾腾、刺骨寒冷，起强调作用。

questions.question: Michelle is said ______ some progress in her scientific research in the past year.
questions.explanation: is said 后接不定式；进步发生在此前一年，用完成式 to have made。

questions.question: When ______, the bridge connecting the island to the continent will be open to traffic next year.
questions.explanation: When completed 相当于 When the bridge is completed；桥被完工后开放，用过去分词。

questions.question: ______ these objections, we can not ignore the advantages of learning through the Internet.
questions.explanation: despite 直接接名词表示尽管，与仍不能忽视优势形成让步关系。

questions.question: Mom enjoyed herself so much ______ she was on vacation in France with dad last year.
questions.explanation: 去掉 so much，主干仍是“度假时玩得很开心”，故 when 表时间。was on vacation 不是“开心”造成的结果，不能看到 so 就机械选 that。

questions.question: "The Prime Minister is to speak on television tonight." The simple present tense in the sentence is used to introduce ______.
questions.explanation: be to do 在此表示正式安排，tonight 指总理已安排的电视讲话。

questions.question: What a pity! If only they ______ here now, we would be able to celebrate their wedding anniversary.
questions.explanation: now 决定是假设现在，用 were。had been 用于对过去的愿望；if only“要是……就好了”与 only if“只有……才”意义不同。

questions.question: Among the four sentences below, Sentence ______ expresses the highest degree of possibility.
questions.explanation: will 在此作肯定的将来预测，确定程度高于 could、may 的可能性及 should 的预期。

questions.question: There ______ be any difficulty in passing the road test since you have practiced a lot in the driving school.
questions.explanation: shouldn't 在此表示按已有练习情况预计不会有困难；mustn't 表禁止，needn't 表不必。

questions.question: ______, he sometimes can not stand the way she solves problems.
questions.explanation: Much as… 是让步结构，意为尽管很喜欢她；程度副词 much 前置。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: His family is well known in this country.
The public were not allowed to hear the trial.
Poultry is expensive at this time of year.
Physics include mechanics, heat, light, etc.

questions.explanation: physics 表示物理学时作单数学科名词，谓语应为 includes；其余集体名词的用法可成立。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is a COMMAND?
questions.explanation: Try that again. 要求再次尝试，是祈使命令；其余分别表达称赞、祝愿或请求原谅。

questions.question: ______ with last year, the output of the factory this year has increased by twenty percent.
questions.explanation: Compared with… 表示与……相比；被比较的是产量，用过去分词。

questions.question: What is the function of the past perfect tense in "When he came in, I had waited for two hours"?

options.text: To show a sequence of events in the past.
To express a wish or regret.

questions.explanation: had waited 表示在 came in 这一过去时点之前已经等待了两小时，标示过去事件的先后。

questions.question: “The next day John went with me to the station, where I bought a ticket for London.” The relative clause in the sentence serves to ______.

options.text: supply additional information about the station
put restrictions on the identity of John

questions.explanation: where I bought… 形式上是非限制性定语从句，语用上推进叙事：到车站后买票，近似 and there I bought…。题目问功能，不只是问从句名称。

questions.question: You can never imagine what great trouble I have had ______ the customer to withdraw a claim.
questions.explanation: 还原：I have had great trouble (in) persuading the customer…。had 在这里是 have trouble 的完成时，不是使役 have sb do；先识别 have trouble doing。

questions.question: At a rough estimate, Nigeria is ______ Great Britain.

options.text: three times as the size of

questions.explanation: 倍数表达为 three times + the size + of，表示面积是另一方的三倍。

questions.question: Which of the italicized parts functions as an attribute?

options.text: He had his leg broken when playing football.
Henry is standing at the front door.

questions.explanation: involved 后置修饰 Everybody，作定语；A、B 为补足语，C 表地点。

questions.question: This poor country has earthquakes in some areas, and ______.
questions.explanation: and 连接 has 的两组宾语：earthquakes in some areas 与 famines in others；others 指其他地区。

questions.question: —Have you returned from Japan yet? —Yes, but I ______ at home for only four days before my company sent me to Australia.
questions.explanation: sent 把“在家待四天”限定为过去结束的时段，用 was。for + 时间长度也能搭配一般过去时，不能看到 for 就自动选现在完成时。

questions.question: ______ we are not asked to fill the readers' feedback, we have no need to do it.
questions.explanation: now that 表既然、由于，引出不必填写反馈的原因；since 作连词时不与 that 连用。

questions.question: They thought her unpractical, which she was not. The relative clause in this sentence ______.
questions.explanation: think her unpractical = 认为她不切实际；which 对应前面的表语 unpractical，which she was not 意为“她其实并非如此”，用来澄清误解。不是解释原因，也不是限制 her 指谁。

questions.question: Our teacher recommended that we ______ as attentive as possible when we visit the museum.
questions.explanation: recommend 表建议，宾语从句用 (should) + 动词原形：we (should) be…。外层 recommended 是过去式，也不能把表示建议的 be 改成 were；shall be 不是这里的虚拟形式。

questions.question: He hardly had time to finish the sound-recording ______ he turned off the radio.
questions.explanation: hardly…when… = 刚……就……；与 no sooner…than… 分开记。此处 hardly 不在句首，不需倒装。若改成 Hardly had he…，才需部分倒装。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: The strike may last another three days.
I’m going camping with other two little boys.
She has got five more electric fans.
You must both come over some evening.

questions.explanation: B 应为 two other little boys。another three days = 另外三天；two other boys = 另外两个男孩；five more fans = 再多五台。both 放在情态动词 must 后、主要动词 come 前，D 正确。

questions.question: It is a fine day today. Let's go to the park for boating, ______?
questions.explanation: Let's… 提出共同活动的建议，反意疑问通常用 shall we?。

questions.question: The simple future tense in “'You will stay here till you are relieved,' said the officer.” is used to indicate ______.
questions.explanation: 军官说 You will stay here…，是命令“你必须留在这里，直到有人接替”。will 在权威口吻中可表达命令，不能一看到 will 就只选 future time。relieve 此处指换岗、接替。

questions.question: It was impossible for you to avoid ______ if you both work in the same office.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动名词，you 是受影响的一方，用 being affected；不接 from 或不定式。

questions.question: A heavy stone fell on the man, who was killed on the spot. The relative clause in this sentence ______.

options.text: supplies additional information about the stone
implies the reason for the event
puts restrictions on the identity of the man
indicates the outcome of the event

questions.explanation: who was killed on the spot 说明石头砸中男子的结果：他当场死亡。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: Fire and water do not agree.
Each minute and each second are valuable.
Bread and butter is a nutritious food for patients.
The scholar and poet is dead.

questions.explanation: each A and each B 强调每一个，用单数 is。C 的 bread and butter 作为一种整体食物；D 单个 the 表示同一位兼具学者与诗人身份的人，均可接 is。不是“两个不可数名词用 and 就单数”。

questions.question: Who ______ was going to visit our company this afternoon?
questions.explanation: 结构是 Who did you say was going to…? 主句 did you say 倒装，后面的主语疑问内容保留 was going to。此处 who 已被提到句首，不再用 that 阻隔这一主语位置的关联。

questions.question: England is justly proud of ______ great poets, especially ______ in the 18th century.
questions.explanation: its 表示英格兰的，those 代指复数 great poets；that 不能指代复数诗人。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: We each has our own view on marriage.
Not you but your father is to blame.
There is a pen and some books on the desk.
His family are waiting for him.

questions.explanation: A 的主语是复数 We，each 为同位性成分，谓语应为 have；B、C 按邻近主语一致，D 指家庭成员。

questions.question: Everyone has got a chance to give a speech, ______?
questions.explanation: Everyone 可用 they 承接；主句为现在完成时肯定句，反意疑问用 haven't they。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences expresses SURPRISE?

options.text: Should it rain tomorrow, I wouldn’t go.
I don’t know why you should think that I did it.
I should say that it would be better to try it again.
You should inform the receptionist of your arrival.

questions.explanation: B：“你怎么竟会觉得是我做的？”A 为 should 条件倒装；C 为委婉提出看法；D 为建议或义务。要从语境识别 should，不要只背一个中文义。

questions.question: If only the victims in the car accident ______ immediate treatment, they might still be alive now.
questions.explanation: 过去没得到及时治疗，用 had received；结果却指向现在 alive now，主句为 might be，而非 might have been。过去原因 + 现在结果，是混合条件。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: We each have our private views about it.
They got two pieces of paper each.
The apples are fifty cents each.
Each they have bought the same blouse.

questions.explanation: each 不能直接放在人称代词 they 前；应为 They each… 或 Each of them…。

questions.question: The situation is rather complicated ______ we have two managing directors.
questions.explanation: in that = because / in the sense that，意为“原因在于、在……方面”。so that 通常表目的或结果；不能把 since 与 that 随意拼成 since that。

questions.question: ______ a dark cloud cannot long hide the sun, ______ no lies can cover up the fact.
questions.explanation: (Just) as…so… = 正如……，……也同样如此。不是 as…as 的程度比较；两个完整分句之间建立类比关系。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: I have read all the books that you gave to me.
This is the last time that I will say these words.
He has reached the point where a change is needed.
I really miss the time when I spent with you.

questions.explanation: D 中 spent 缺宾语，关系词应为 that/which 或省略；when 只能作时间状语。

questions.question: He believes in private ownership, which idea we are quite opposed to. The relative clause in this sentence is used to ______.

options.text: play devil's advocate in the discussion
show the speaker has an innovative view
express the speaker's stance about the idea

questions.explanation: which idea 指前面的私有制观念，we are quite opposed to 表明说话者反对的立场。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: He earns twice as much as he used to.
The width of this new road is two times that of the old one.
This book is four times more expensive than that one.
The new square is four times size that of the previous one.

questions.explanation: D 的倍数结构错误，应为 four times the size of…；A、B 结构成立，C 是教材常见比较级倍数表达。

questions.question: So sudden ______ that people in the building had no time to escape.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词位于句首时，系动词 be 与主语倒装：So sudden was the attack that…。

questions.question: The present perfect in "I've been there already and don't want to go there again" is used to ______.

options.text: provide a reason for the decision
to emphasize a fact known to both

questions.explanation: 现在完成时说明已有的经历，并为现在不想再去的决定提供理由。

questions.question: ______ is announced in the papers, our country has launched a largescale movement against smuggling and fraudulent activities in foreign currency exchange deals.
questions.explanation: As is announced… 为前置的非限制性定语从句，as 指后面整个分句；what、that 不能构成此结构。

questions.question: ______ you ______ any doubt on the delivery receipt, contact us at 4008 9666.
questions.explanation: Should you have… = If you should have…，“万一有疑问，请联系”。这是将来可能条件，可直接接祈使主句，不要求主句也用 would。

questions.question: The sentence that expresses REQUEST is ______.

options.text: Take it easy. It'll be OK.

questions.explanation: C 的 Please 引出礼貌请求；A 命令，B 安慰，D 欢迎。

questions.question: I believe watching TV is ______ listening to radio.

options.text: as good as or better than

questions.explanation: 并列的是 as good as 与 better than，两个结构都要保留各自搭配：as good as or better than…。不能只留最后一个连接词凑成一组。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: She spends lots of money on makeup each year.
He always has a great amount of work to do.
Tom bought a few furniture for his new house.
A great quantity of flowers were placed in the hall.

questions.explanation: furniture 是不可数名词，不能由 a few 修饰；可说 some furniture 或 a few pieces of furniture。

questions.question: —Do you know Jim has broken up with his wife? —I don't know, ______.
questions.explanation: nor 表示也不，引起部分倒装：nor do I care；不再重复否定 don't。

questions.question: He invested his money in many companies, three of which went bankrupt within five months. The relative clause in this sentence is used to ______.

options.text: indicate a low degree of possibility
express a goal difficult to achieve
overstate the bad result of the case

questions.explanation: three of which went bankrupt 交代投资后的不利结果；没有表示可能性、目的或夸张。

questions.question: If given ______ hours, Jack surely can have all the tasks done.
questions.explanation: another two hours 表示再给两小时；another 可放在数词和复数名词前。

questions.question: An actor cannot well play the role without life experience ______ a dancer can make a difference without much practice.
questions.explanation: not/cannot A any more than B = 正如 B 不能一样，A 也不能。前面已经有 cannot，后面用 any more than；不是再添一个 no more than。两项都是说缺少积累就无法成功。

questions.question: It is said that more than one organization ______ in this well-known criminal case.
questions.explanation: more than one + 单数名词，意义不止一个，语法上通常仍接单数谓语；be involved in 涉及、卷入。不是按中文“不止一个组织”就选 were。

questions.question: We are rejoiced that you should have achieved such great successes in your work. The italicized verb phrase is used to express ______.
questions.explanation: 情绪类 should have achieved 表“竟已取得”，成就实际上发生了，并非“本应取得但没有”。have done 只说明事情先已完成；与后悔义 should have done 要按语境区分。

questions.question: Time ______, both my parents will attend his wedding ceremony.
questions.explanation: Time permitting 是独立主格，相当于 If time permits；time 与 permit 为主动关系。

questions.question: How can I ever complete it if you ______ continually ______ me so many silly questions?
questions.explanation: are continually asking 表示当下不断提问，进行时与 continually 连用可表达不满。

questions.question: A: Are you going to see a film? B: I'm not sure. I ______ go fishing instead.
questions.explanation: I'm not sure 表明尚未决定，might 表示可能改去钓鱼。

questions.question: Every means ______ tried out but none works. I have run out of my patience.
questions.explanation: means 单复数同形；Every means 按单数，用 has。run out of patience 与“试过仍不奏效”的结果对应，选完成时被动 has been tried out。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?

options.text: Both his parents agree to buy a new car.
He has cleaned all these dirty shoes.
He is so thirsty that he drinks much the water.
She writes the answers on every other line.

questions.explanation: much 不能直接置于 the water 前，应为 much water 或 much of the water；其余限定词用法成立。

questions.question: ______ for the fact that his father was in hospital, he might have gone abroad.
questions.explanation: Had it not been for… = If it had not been for…，“要不是……”。might have gone 对过去虚拟，从句用 had been；倒装时 not 通常仍在主语 it 后，不写成 Hadn’t it…。

questions.question: Health is ______ counts most.
questions.explanation: what 引导表语从句并作 counts 的主语，意为最重要的事情。

questions.question: There must be someone else who killed the fish. Lily is ______ girl to do such a thing.
questions.explanation: too + 形容词 + a/an + 单数名词 + to do = 太……而不能做。too timid a girl“胆子太小的女孩”；C 的 so timid a 可作名词短语，却不能独立表达这里的 too…to 否定结果。

questions.question: The thermometer is a useful instrument, by means of which we measure the temperature of different kinds of things. The relative clause in this sentence is used to ______.

options.text: describe the function of the thermometer
introduce a wide range of uses
tell us how to use the thermometer
reveal the shortcoming of the thermometer

questions.explanation: 关系从句说明温度计用于测量温度这一功能，未具体教授操作方法。

questions.question: What should I have done in Tom’s place? The italicized part of the sentence expresses ______.
questions.explanation: in Tom’s place = 假如我是 Tom、处在他的境地，语义上提供隐含条件，因此是 hypothesis。不是具体坐在 Tom 的位置上。

questions.question: ______ from each other, they get along well and can always find a balance.
questions.explanation: Much as they differ = Although they differ a lot，“尽管差异很大”。把程度副词 much 前置到 as 前，后面仍是主语 + 谓语；同类有 Old as…、Child as…。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is CORRECT?

options.text: Henry is so hungry that he eats all of apples that you give him.
Henry is so hungry that he eats the all apples that you give him.
Henry is so hungry that he eats whole the apples that you give him.
Henry is so hungry that he eats all the apples that you give him.

questions.explanation: all the apples 的限定词次序正确；all of 后接带限定词的名词短语，whole 不能这样修饰复数 apples。
